extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Animal characteristics — animals can move from place to place, animals grow, animals eat food (plants or other animals), animals breathe, animals reproduce. (2) Animal habitats — water (fish, frog, duck), trees (bird, monkey, squirrel), underground (rabbit, snake, earthworm), grass/land (cow, sheep, dog, horse). (3) Life cycle of butterfly — 1. Egg (laid on leaf by butterfly) → 2. Caterpillar/larva (hatches from egg, eats leaves, grows) → 3. Chrysalis/Pupa (caterpillar forms a hard case, changes inside) → 4. Butterfly (comes out of pupa, has wings, flies, lays eggs). Misconceptions: 'caterpillar is a baby butterfly' (caterpillar is the LARVA stage, not a baby butterfly — it changes inside the chrysalis), 'animals can make their own food like plants' (animals cannot make food, they eat plants or other animals), 'fish can live on land' (fish need water to breathe and live), 'butterfly comes out of an egg directly' (egg becomes caterpillar, then pupa, THEN butterfly). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AnimalsGame), NOT export default. Export interface AnimalsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
